note: Circuit traits are this project's own judgement, not data from any source. Only well-established traits are listed (1 to 3 per circuit); when unsure, a trait is left off. Keyed by Jolpica circuit id.

albert_park.reason: Temporary circuit on public park roads around Albert Park lake.

americas.reason: Permanent circuit whose first sector is a run of fast esses.

baku.reason: City street circuit with a flat-out run of about 2 km to the finish line.

catalunya.reason: Long fast corners (turns 3 and 9) make it a classic aero benchmark.

hungaroring.reason: Slow, twisty and hard to pass on; usually run in midsummer heat.

interlagos.reason: About 800 m above sea level, which lowers downforce and cooling.

jeddah.reason: Fast street circuit of flat-out sweeps and long straights.

losail.reason: Flowing medium and high-speed corners; hot and humid in Qatar.

madring.reason: New semi-street circuit around the IFEMA area of Madrid.

marina_bay.reason: Slow street circuit with many corners, in hot and very humid conditions.

miami.reason: Temporary circuit around the Hard Rock Stadium; hot and humid in Miami.

monaco.reason: Tight street circuit run with maximum downforce.

monza.reason: The lowest-drag, most power-sensitive circuit on the calendar.

red_bull_ring.reason: Short lap dominated by three uphill and downhill straights.

rodriguez.reason: About 2,200 m above sea level, with a very long main straight.

sepang.reason: Fast sweeping corners; hot and humid in Malaysia.

shanghai.reason: Back straight of over 1 km, one of the longest on the calendar.

silverstone.reason: Fast sweeps such as Copse and Maggotts-Becketts.

spa.reason: Long flat-out stretch through Eau Rouge to Les Combes, plus fast corners like Pouhon.

vegas.reason: Street circuit with the long Strip straight, run with low drag.

villeneuve.reason: Stop-go layout of straights and chicanes, run with low downforce.

yas_marina.reason: Long back straight of over 1 km after the hairpin.

zandvoort.reason: Narrow, twisty and banked, run with high downforce; overtaking is hard.
